purpose: Material for world-projected 2:1 isometric stair treads and vertical risers; not a billboard staircase
prompt: Seamless square orthographic pixel-art hand-cut golden sandstone masonry, staggered irregular blocks, chipped bevels, fine chisel marks and pits, honey ochre palette, fully opaque edge-to-edge, no perspective or objects.
sampling: nearest; repeated every 4 world units; UV continuous along each terrain strip
geometry: horizontal treads at strip midpoint height; vertical risers; segments at most 0.65 world units, subdivided further on tall terrain (at least 24 segments per height unit); existing smooth movement height retained
